text.p: Gannett Co Inc said it made two executive appointments on Monday.
Brooks Johnson, previously president of The San Bernardino County (Calif.) Sun becomes president of Media West-RNI Inc.
Details about the status of the most recent Media West president, Evan Ray, were not immediately known. Neither a Gannett spokeswoman, nor Ray were available for comment.
Mark Adkins, previously president at the North Hills News Record in suburban Pittsburgh, succeeds Johnson as president and publisher in San Bernardino.
Media West is a wholly-owned subsidiary that manages royalty-earning investments. It is based in Reno, Nev.
Gannett publishes 89 daily newspapers, and operates 18 television stations, five radio stations, cable television systems in five states and alarm security services.
